limitations.artifact_download_count: Artifact download_count is omitted by some API responses; when present it is an artifact lifetime counter, not a per-run count. Download steps are measured per run.
limitations.artifact_step_counts: The run/job API omits an action's uses value. Upload/download step counts are inferred from step names; artifact count and size use the artifact API.
limitations.billing_cost: N/A: GitHub billing data is outside the read-only Actions run API; runner minutes are not billed minutes.
limitations.cache_hits_misses: N/A: the Actions run/job API does not expose cache hit outputs; raw job logs were not collected.
limitations.changed_components: PR runs use associated pull request files when available; push/tag runs use head commit files. Only component names are retained.
limitations.failure_flake: Failure and cancellation rates come from conclusions. Retry count is reported; a flake rate is not inferred from retries alone.
limitations.native_macos: Record matching runs available; zero does not count as release PASS.
limitations.runner_cold_warm: N/A: runner warmness is not represented by the run/job API.
limitations.step_queue_time: N/A: the step API exposes start and completion timestamps, not a queued timestamp.

collection.selection: Newest completed workflow runs in each population; native release populations contain the available matching tag or manual runs.

timing_method.run_queue: workflow created_at to first job start
timing_method.runner_minutes: sum of non-skipped job execution durations; parallel jobs are summed separately from wall-clock
timing_method.workflow_elapsed: workflow created_at to latest job completion
timing_method.workflow_wall: first job start to latest job completion
